structured_output.what_is_happening: "Muse Protocol" ($Protocol) is a 37-minute-old token trading on a PumpSwap pool. The pool was not created by a pump.fun bonding-curve graduation: migrated_unix is 0 and the launchpad is unknown. The Pump Fun AMM account holds 78% of supply, and 0% of the LP is locked or burned. RugCheck flags "Large Amount of LP Unlocked" as danger and "few LP providers" as a warning. Liquidity (~$272k) is larger than market cap (~$175k). In one hour the coin traded $5.9M, 21x its market cap, and price rose ~87%. The flow is very lopsided: 2,030 unique buyers against only 63 unique sellers, who made 3,754 sells between them (~60 sells per seller). Holders are spread evenly and thinly (top holder 1.23%), and GMGN tags 50 bundler wallets with an 18% top-bundler share. Two same-name clones have already appeared. The dev's X account has launched 15 tokens, and the site museprotocol.lol is a throwaway .lol domain.

narrative.description: The name and site suggest a vague 'protocol' or launch-platform AI-style concept. There is no DexScreener profile, no socials beyond one X handle, and no visible story beyond the name.
narrative.why_spreading: The activity looks driven by volume and bots rather than by a story. Turnover is extreme, a few sellers trade over and over, and the thin, even holder distribution fits sybil or bot buyers. Clone tokens appearing shows copycat deployers are reacting to the volume, not that real interest exists.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the earliest pair (created 08:22 UTC) and by far the most liquid and active of the three 'Muse Protocol' tokens. It is linked to the museprotocol.lol site and the @museprotocollol handle.
token_connection.competing_tokens: AttLKdv1... ($88k mcap, $108k h1 volume, created ~22 min later) and ARQY3A8b... ($53k mcap, created ~34 min later). Both are copycats.

authenticity.evidence: There are 63 unique sellers against 2,030 buyers, with ~60 sells per seller, which points to wash or market-making bots. GMGN tags 50 bundler wallets with an 18% top-bundler share. Turnover is 21x market cap in one hour. The pool was self-seeded outside the bonding curve, and the LP is fully unlocked and held by a few providers. The dev's X account has launched 15 prior tokens, and the creator's best ATH (~$181k) matches this token's current ATH. There is no paid promotion, no smart-money wallets and no KOL wallets.
authenticity.uncertainty: There is no X or Telegram data. The low seller count could partly mean real buyers are holding, and the flat holder distribution could be an airdrop rather than sybil wallets.

structural_risks: The LP is 0% locked or burned and was deployed directly by a few providers, so it can be pulled at any time
Liquidity is larger than market cap, which suggests the dev seeded the pool and controls the exit liquidity
About 60 sells per seller wallet indicates wash or bot volume
50 bundler wallets with an 18% top-bundler trader share
A serial-launching dev X account (15 tokens) on a throwaway .lol domain

structured_output.counterargument: The buy side is broad. Over 2,000 distinct buyers, a rising buy/sell ratio, no single holder above 1.23%, renounced mint and freeze authorities, no sell tax and no paid promotion all describe a coin getting real attention. Deep liquidity and a canonical position against the clones could let it keep running. A move from ~$175k to ~$350k is modest for a coin that already moved 87% in an hour, so a double in 6 hours is plausible if the momentum is real.

structured_output.thesis: The structure looks like a dev-seeded PumpSwap pool with fully unlocked LP, wash-style volume from few sellers, and bundlers, all run by a serial-launching X account. The most likely path is a pump-and-pull or a fade within hours. Doubling from the entry price before a -50% move or an LP pull is unlikely.
